title: German Federal IT Procurement Tender (Framework Agreements)
funding_amount: Contract value varies depending on tender scope (to be specified per call)
eligibility: Companies capable of delivering IT hardware, software, or digital infrastructure services in compliance with German public procurement requirements (e.g., technical capability, certifications, financial standing).
geographic_eligibility: Suppliers must be able to deliver services within Germany and comply with EU procurement regulations.
application_deadline: Varies by individual tender (rolling publication on official portals)
official_source_name: e-Vergabe (German Federal Procurement Portal) / TED (Tenders Electronic Daily)
verification_notes: Based on official German and EU procurement portals where tenders are continuously published. Individual contracts must be accessed through official listings.
funding_objective: Procurement of IT infrastructure, software, and services for public sector institutions in Germany.
short_summary: Public procurement opportunities for IT suppliers providing hardware, software, and digital services to German federal and regional authorities.
full_description: German public procurement opportunities are regularly published through official platforms such as e-Vergabe and TED. These tenders cover a wide range of IT-related contracts, including hardware supply, cloud services, cybersecurity, and enterprise software solutions. Companies must meet strict technical, financial, and compliance requirements to participate. Contracts vary in size and complexity depending on the issuing authority.
application_process: Register on official procurement portals (e-Vergabe or TED), monitor relevant tenders, submit technical and financial proposals within the specified deadlines.
required_documents: Technical proposal, financial bid, company certifications (e.g., ISO standards if required), proof of financial stability, compliance declarations.
incubator_or_partner_support: Consortium participation or partnerships may strengthen bids for larger contracts.
